name: Love To Hate You
source:
You lost your job. Forced to move into a shared apartment, you quickly realize you're going to be living with the people who got you fired.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你丢了工作，被迫搬进一间合租公寓，却很快发现自己的合租室友竟然就是害你被炒鱿鱼的罪魁祸首。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
